record: Spread 23-11 · ML 27-7 · POTD L
summary: None of the 11 spread losses were bad beats - 2 were close losses (CLE, MEM in OT) and the other 9 were real misses.

record: Spread 2-3 · ML 5-0 · POTD W
summary: Light five-game CBB night: every favorite won (ML 5-0) but sides went 2-3, and both spread wins were backdoor covers. No bad beats - UK was a garbage-time close loss and the other two misses were real.
went_well: Not much to credit on the sides: Drexel +31.5 and Sam Houston +26.5 only got there with late garbage-time runs after trailing by 36 and 32, so those were lucky wins, not proof. The ML read was right across the board, and the Sam Houston pick did correctly bake in Alabama playing without Holloway.
went_wrong: Wofford +26.5 leaned on Tennessee's ugly exhibitions, but the Vols ran away with a 36-10 burst after half - a bad read on early-season noise. UAPB +38.5 counted on Calipari resting starters, and Arkansas won by 45 anyway; the market (and Kalshi at -40.5) had the better number. UK -32.5 was a tiny 1.5-pt edge on a huge number and the bench gave it back late.
improve: New L004: in CBB games with a 25+ point spread, only take the underdog when the model's edge is 5+ points - big dogs are 4-4 over two days with both of today's wins being backdoors, while laying 23.5+ is 7-3.

record: Spread 9-5 · ML 9-5 · POTD L

The road-dominance read on POR -3.5 (won by 13) and fading tired Toronto with DEN -4.5 (won by 19) were right too; NOP -5.5 only got there in OT, so don't count that one.

improve: New L005: when an NBA favorite of -5+ is priced up mostly because the other team is banged up, only lay it with a 2+ pt model edge - MEM -6.5 on a 1.5-pt edge lost outright to depleted Indiana. Also treat a line move against the public as a tiebreaker, not a reason on its own: DET -2.5 leaned on that and lost by 6.

record: Spread 6-5 · ML 10-1 · POTD W

went_wrong: Both small-edge plays on short-handed teams were bad reads: Ravens +10.5 with a rookie QB lost by 23 after three turnovers, and Orlando without Banchero and Suggs coughed it up 25 times and lost by 13 to a Suns team on a back-to-back. improve: New L006: when backing a team missing its starting QB or two-plus starters, require a 2+ point edge or side with the healthy team - it's the mirror of L005, which keeps us from overrating those injuries the other way. Keep using L004 on 25+ CBB spreads (3-0 so far), but don't change how we handle laying big CBB numbers off one 4-3 night - TTU and ARIZ were the market being right, not a pattern yet.

season:
- 306 games graded since Nov 2.
- Against the spread, all games: 153-152-1 (50.2%, 95% range 45-56%). That's basically a coin flip and still under the 52.4% break-even, which is normal for the data-collection phase.
- Official plays (started Nov 13): 6-3 (67%). Way too few to mean anything yet.
- Closing line value: 36 picks beat the closing number and 12 got a worse one (average +0.14 points). That's the most encouraging sign so far, but part of it comes from taking the better number between DraftKings and FanDuel.
- Favorites 118-104 (53%), underdogs 35-48-1 (42%). Taking points with underdogs has hurt; L011 is testing that.
- By edge size: under 1 pt 53-58 (48%), 1-2 pts 59-55-1 (52%), 2-3 pts 28-23 (55%), 3+ pts 13-16 (45%). The 3+ point edges doing worst fits the "big edges are a warning" rule.
- By league: NFL 18-11 (62%), NBA 53-52 (50%), CFB 33-33 (50%), CBB 49-56-1 (47%). NFL looks best but it's a small sample.
- By week: week of Nov 2 86-65 (57%), week of Nov 9 67-87-1 (44%). That swing is mostly normal noise, a good reminder that hot and cold stretches don't last.
- The moneyline record of 237-68-1 (78%) looks great but is misleading: it's high mostly because the model usually picks the favorite.

record: Official 5-14 (26%) · Spread 72-84 (46.2% vs 52.4% breakeven, 95% range 39-54%) · ML 109-47 · POTD 3-4 · 3 bad beats in 84 spread losses · CLV +0.1
summary: A second straight losing week on the full board at 72-84 ATS, though 109-47 straight up with a small positive CLV. Only 3 of the 84 spread losses were bad beats and 4 of the 72 wins were lucky; most losses were tagged bad reads (24) or line-was-right (14), so this wasn't just bad luck.
went_well: CBB was the best league at 29-26 ATS (53%, 42-13 ML), and spread underdogs went 40-36 (53%), with NBA dogs getting lots of points against short-handed favorites covering often (IND, GSW, SAC). season:
- 462 games graded since Nov 2 (one CBB game was postponed and counts as a push).
- Against the spread, all games: 225-236-1 (48.8%, 95% range 44-53%). That's still a coin flip and under the 52.4% break-even.
- Official plays (started Nov 13): 11-17 (39%, 95% range 24-58%). Only 28 picks, so it can't tell us much yet, but it's worth watching.
- Closing line value: 62 picks beat the closing number and 23 got a worse one (average +0.14 points on 310 tracked). Still the most encouraging sign, though small, and partly from shopping between DraftKings and FanDuel.
- Favorites 150-152 (50%), underdogs 75-84-1 (47%). The gap is within normal noise.
- By edge size: under 1 pt 78-81 (49%), 1-2 pts 77-78-1 (50%), 2-3 pts 40-42 (49%), 3+ pts 30-35 (46%). Bigger edges haven't won more, so the model's confidence isn't predicting anything yet.

- By week: Nov 2-8 86-65 (57%), Nov 9-15 67-87 (44%), Nov 16-22 72-84 (46%).
- Simple controls on the same games: always the favorite 49%, always the home team 48%, ratings only 49%. The model is about where those are, so it isn't beating simple rules yet. Formula v1 tracking starts Dec 14.

improve: 1) Official plays are 11-17: the pregame check should confirm each one has a reason beyond recent results and agrees with the ratings side unless there's a specific stated reason (L018), and keep logging them. 2) Tag L019 when a pick leans mainly on a team's last game (VT on Sunday), so the recency idea actually gets tested. 3) CFB is 46-57 on the season; keep collecting under L011/L012 rather than adding a new rule. Status changes this week: L008 (split picks) went Testing -> Dropped at 25-26 after 51 picks; L018-L021 were added Nov 16 and all stay Testing; nothing is close to Keep.
